name: Ramp
text:
Add a 4px focus ring with a 2px offset to every interactive element that gets keyboard focus.

This makes the focus indicator visible on all devices and under all lighting conditions while keeping it from overlapping nearby elements. The trade-off is slightly more space taken up by the ring, but that’s outweighed by ensuring no one misses where they are on the screen.

name: Reader
text: Risk: A 4px ring with 2px offset still risks failing 4.5:1 contrast on dark backgrounds. Better alternative: Use a 3px ring with 3px offset—it keeps the indicator visible without crowding and meets contrast on both light and dark modes. Settle it with a quick color-contrast check in both themes.

name: Reader
text: Risk: A 3px ring with 3px offset still risks failing 4.5:1 contrast on dark backgrounds when the ring color is too light. Better alternative: Use a 4px ring with 3px offset—it widens the ring slightly without crowding and meets contrast in both themes. Settle it with a color-contrast check in both light and dark modes using a tool like WebAIM’s Contrast Checker.
